rationale: gray_q directly converts an enabled +1 binary counter and every bit has a clean depth-2 chain, so CDC-018 applies; no set_max_delay -datapath_only bound exists, so it stays WARNING Unresolved. author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: A direct plus-one source feeds a registered Gray conversion and two exact stages per bit. No datapath-only max delay is supplied, and the asynchronous group does not bound inter-bit arrival.
labels.suspected_flaw: The contract calls the counter free-running, but inc_sync_i gates increments and the binary state lacks initialization.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The 4-bit Gray-coded pointer gray_q[3:0] (src_clk, design.sv:19) crosses into dst_clk through a clean 2-stage synchronizer (s1_q -> s2_q, design.sv:21-22), but intent.sdc provides no set_max_delay -datapath_only constraint bounding inter-bit datapath skew across the crossing (and separates the clocks with set_clock_groups -asynchronous), leaving the Gray skew timing obligation unresolved (CDC-018 WARNING Unresolved).
